changelog:
Initial release of Claw Insights Install skill.

- Provides one-command installation and setup guide for Claw Insights dashboard.
- Details prerequisites: Node.js ≥ 22.5, running OpenClaw gateway.
- Includes common run, stop, restart, and configuration commands.
- Features troubleshooting steps and environment variable reference.
- Offers guidance on verifying installation and upgrading.
- Highlights local-only, non-intrusive, and privacy-focused operation.
